text:
mira: quick heads-up — PR #8342 (alloc-tiling) is ready for merge but my long-seq microbench shows a p95 bump; want a sanity check before the merge window at 15:00 PT. pinging @ben_s @arjun_r :eyes:

ben_s: saw the CI, tests are clean. can you paste the bench output here? was the run stable or noisy?

arjun_r: if it's just a small p95 bump we can canary it. what's the delta and which config (batch/horizon) did you run?

mira: ran the longseq stress harness on prod-like infra (8x A100 equiv, seq=4096, batch horizon=64). three runs, median numbers below. noticed the p95 tail specifically for models with long kv cache.

mira: ```
# before (main) - longseq microbench (tokens/s, ms per token)
model: rwd-13b-tiling
seq=4096 horizon=64
median latency p50: 92ms
p95: 112ms
throughput: 78 tok/s

# after (PR #8342) - alloc-tiling adjustment
median latency p50: 95ms
p95: 174ms  <-- regression
throughput: 76 tok/s
notes: increased tail on shard spill path, mem stable
```

zoe_ops: thanks for pasting — CI artifacts include perf traces (ci-bot linked them). looks like a KV shard rebalance edge case where one worker hits a slightly higher lock contention.

ci-bot: perf-trace: https://ci.example.com/artifacts/8342/trace.html (flame + mutex timeline).

ben_s: hmm 60ms p95 delta is non-trivial. do we have flame graphs across the three runs to confirm it's deterministic? could be a noisy host in one run.

mira: checked — two of three runs show the bump, so probably real. I tried disabling a micro-optimization in the PR and that removed the spike, so it's connected to the new allocation ordering.

arjun_r: can you point to the allocation lines? I can do a quick review and suggest a minimal revert if needed.

mira: in the PR diff it's the allocator::try_merge_ranges change around line 312. my hypothesis: merge ordering causes more frequent mutex handoffs under specific shard fragmentation.

ben_s: @arjun_r if you can +1 the code change with a note to monitor canary we can merge and roll a canary with 5% traffic. otherwise we hold until a small tweak lands.

arjun_r: i'm taking a look now, should be able to comment within 20m. if it's a simple ordering fix i'm fine with a canary.

zoe_ops: FYI scheduling: the next merge slot is 15:00 PT, canary rollout window 15:15–16:15. if we merge, I'll plan the canary and watch p95 across tenants. :white_check_mark:

mira: thanks — I'll post a short follow-up with the tiny revert candidate in case we need it. also adding a small bench script tweak to capture per-shard lock wait times.

ben_s: thumbs up. if @arjun_r flags nothing critical, i'll drop a +1 and we merge into the slot. otherwise revert candidate ready. :+1:

arjun_r: quick review done — safe to canary but leave the revert PR open as a hotfix. added one nit comment on a comment typo. +1 from me for canary.

mira: perfect, merging to canary in 10. will paste canary metrics here once rolling.

ci-bot: merge: PR #8342 merged to canary branch by mira at 3347212700.

mira: canary started — watching p95 now. initial tail looks slightly higher but stabilizing. will update at +15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
